title: Revit Annotation Type Governed Fields

entries.name: Annotation class
entries.requirement: Each governed annotation type shall identify whether it is text, dimension, tag, symbol, keynote, spot annotation, or another approved annotation class.

entries.name: Type identity
entries.requirement: Each governed annotation type shall have a stable identity sufficient to distinguish it from local duplicates or ad-hoc variants.

entries.name: Intended use
entries.requirement: Each governed annotation type shall declare its intended use and applicable documentation context.

entries.name: Applicable discipline or scope
entries.requirement: Where annotation behavior is discipline-specific, the applicable discipline or scope shall be declared.

entries.name: Display properties
entries.requirement: The governed type shall reference or declare the approved display properties required for its class, such as font, paper text size, line/leader behavior, symbol form, or equivalent.

entries.name: Units and precision basis
entries.requirement: Dimension and numerical annotation types shall reference the applicable governed units, precision, rounding, and tolerance basis rather than relying on uncontrolled local settings.

entries.name: Parameter dependencies
entries.requirement: Where annotation content is data-driven, the type shall reference the governed parameter identities or parameter registry on which it depends.

entries.name: Library or template source
entries.requirement: Governed annotation types shall be traceable to the approved template, family library, or other controlled source from which project instances are derived.

entries.name: Change control
entries.requirement: Changes to governed annotation types shall follow standards governance and shall not be introduced as untracked project-local variants.

non_promoted_source_content: No source TODO font family, paper text size, line spacing, color, dimension precision, arrow/tick style, or tolerance value is promoted as an enterprise default.
No placeholder annotation type name from the source is treated as canonical until separately approved.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable machine-readable fields required to govern annotation types while retaining unresolved style values as configuration data.
